summary.headline: Khazanchi Q1 FY27 revenue rose 45% YoY to INR586.36 crore and PAT 84% to INR27.83 crore, with EBITDA margin at 6.82%.
summary.overview: Revenue grew 45% YoY to INR586.36 crore, EBITDA rose 89% to INR39.98 crore and PAT rose 84% to INR27.83 crore, with margins expanding 158 bps (EBITDA) and 99 bps (PAT). Management attributed the quarter to the first full quarter of the new flagship showroom and ERP rollout. The company is migrating from BSE SME to the main boards of BSE and NSE, which management expects to complete in about 2 months, and it reiterated a INR5,000 crore revenue target by FY30 with 25-30% growth and B2C reaching ~40% of revenue. Several answers were vague (volume split, store capex, quantum sold), and the call ran on a mix of expansion plans and operating metrics.

financial_highlights.change: +45% YoY vs INR403.84 crore in Q1 FY26
Management said grams/quantum sold implied by ~15% growth; exact grams to be shared later
Inventory turnover days 73 vs 63 in Q4 FY26
Revenue ~5x and PAT ~10x since FY23 (INR481 crore revenue, INR8 crore PAT)

segments.name: B2B (wholesale)
segments.commentary: Management described B2B as the scale and stability base, with ~1,000 clients, none above 5-6% of revenue, and a targeted 25% growth. Working cycle is ~40-45 days. Higher-margin Kundan Jadau and diamond jewellery were added to B2B.

segments.name: B2C (retail)
segments.commentary: Flagship showroom is targeted at ~INR500 crore annual revenue, with management saying it is achieving 80-85% of that; current monthly run-rate is ~INR30-35 crore. Retail working cycle is ~100-120 days. Target is 40% of revenue by FY30, from a current share the company did not state precisely.

guidance_outlook: Revenue target of ~INR5,000 crore by FY30, with growth of 25-30% per year (management said both revenue and PAT CAGR of 25-30%, clarified in the call).
Management now expects ~30% full-year growth if current pace holds, with B2B growing ~25%.
B2C to reach ~40% of revenue by FY30; plan of 8-10 stores over 3-4 years, initially in Tamil Nadu, company-owned only, with later expansion to other states (Andhra named as next).
Main board migration to BSE and NSE: documents to be submitted shortly; completion expected in about 2 months, subject to regulatory approvals.
Management expects positive operating cash flow in FY27 after a negative FY26, as stock build for new stores normalises.
capex_capacity: 8-10 retail stores planned by FY30, a mix of flagship showrooms and minimal-jewellery boutiques; capex per store not defined until formats and venues are finalised.
Flagship showroom is company-owned; management said the model going forward is asset-light, with leased properties for new stores.
Funding: internal accruals first, with debt or other means if needed. Bank limit of INR100 crore; management said the only borrowing is working-capital, with no long-term debt.
Gold savings scheme app and a B2B product-selection app are live; an e-commerce platform for lightweight, minimal, diamond, rose gold and silver jewellery is due shortly.
demand_pricing: Management said demand is strong into the marriage and festive season, and order books are in execution; it did not quantify advance bookings.
Gold price spikes cause a 2-week slowdown in sales, which management says is normal and digested.
Old gold exchange is 15-20% of total sales, up from last year.
Bridal and wedding jewellery is ~60% of sales (management's broad estimate; no exact split is maintained).
Making charges are protected by design differentiation and direct manufacturing, which management says gives better pricing than peers.
Marketing spend is 5-7% of total earnings (management's figure).
Standard lead times range 7-21 days for customised orders, mainly for handmade designs.

qa_highlights.question: Where is the main board migration and when will listing happen?
qa_highlights.answer: Documentation submission is underway and will be completed shortly. Management expects migration to finish in about 2 months.

qa_highlights.question: What is the underlying volume growth and grams sold in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said quantum growth was around 15%. It deferred the exact gram figure and asked the analyst to email for it.

qa_highlights.question: How is the new flagship performing vs target?
qa_highlights.answer: Target is ~INR500 crore annual revenue, with management reporting 80-85% achievement. Current monthly run-rate is ~INR30-35 crore. No store EBITDA was disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 25-30% growth target for revenue or PAT, and what is the path to INR5,000 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said both revenue and PAT are targeted at 25-30% growth, and that 5,000 crore is reachable through B2B and B2C growth plus new showrooms by FY30. The answer was not clear on the split.

qa_highlights.question: Working capital days and cash flow outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Wholesale cycle ~40-45 days, retail ~100-120 days. Management said FY27 cash flow should be positive, though it gave no quantum.

qa_highlights.question: Is there any long-term debt?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no long-term debt; the INR100 crore bank limit is used only for working capital.

qa_highlights.question: Store capex and format for the 8-10 new stores?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said capex per store and format will be defined once venues are finalised. Capex was not quantified.

qa_highlights.question: Share of B2B revenue from the top 10 clients?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said no single client exceeds 5-6% of total revenue.

risks_watch: Growth targets are not backed by a stated volume/price split or grams sold; the quantum figure was deferred.
Retail working-capital intensity (100-120 day cycle) and rising inventory (INR460 crore) could keep cash flow negative despite the FY27 positive-cash guidance.
Store-level profitability and capex per store are undisclosed; the flagship's store EBITDA was not given.
Gold price volatility and a 2-week demand slowdown after sharp price moves.
Main board migration is subject to regulatory approvals and has not yet been filed.
Competition from large organised chains and regional jewellers; management gave no quantified pricing data.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the top-line and margin trend, with repeated reference to the INR5,000 crore FY30 target. Answers on store capex, store-level economics, grams sold and the exact growth split were vague or deferred, and the 25-30% target was clarified mid-call (both revenue and PAT).
